finding_reviews.statement: The original compact history model slightly improves a residual kernel on average, but misses a simpler lag-two control.
finding_reviews.historical_evidence_status: Original historical reserve status is retained in source records; every outcome is exposed now. Continuation model selection uses development evidence but cannot restore fresh confirmation.
finding_reviews.strongest_adverse_evidence: The compact model loses 2/3 runs against kernel; one lost probe has no RTT and remains missing. A 1.68 %mean gain does not identify scheduler/queue physics.

reliability.rationale: The retained evidence supports the stated narrow conclusion under Complete PING runs with successful-response targets; five completed prior probes and causal radio data, not target sequence/timestamp/parity. Strong adverse evidence: The compact model loses 2/3 runs against kernel; one lost probe has no RTT and remains missing. A 1.68 %mean gain does not identify scheduler/queue physics.

mechanism.rationale: Observed short-history recurrence supports forecasting; its network origin and lost-packet reliability remain unidentified.

novelty.rationale: Persistence/filtering families are known; an omitted-comparator correction is valuable methodological evidence, not new communications physics. This review uses retained prior-art records only; it performs no new literature priority adjudication.

significance.rationale: The measured endpoint and matched controls supply a useful reproducible local benchmark. Complete PING runs with successful-response targets; five completed prior probes and causal radio data, not target sequence/timestamp/parity.

reproducibility.rationale: Frozen equations/model states and numerical evidence are present and hash-bound here. This scientific document review is separate from independent computational replay; execution validity must be supplied by that review and the raw-preparation audit.

impact.rationale: Potential monitoring, calibration or experiment-planning value is bounded by the stated endpoint. No operational intervention, measured deployment savings, clinical effect or independent real-world benefit is demonstrated in this portfolio.

scientific_validators: Include lag-two persistence with identical information access.
Keep missing lost-probe RTTs unscored but assigned, and never use lost flags or current response timestamps as predictors.
Treat 50 msdecision thresholds as illustrative unless a service requirement is independently documented.
